scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @excelmaster/web" "npm run dev -w @excelmaster/api" "npm run dev -w @excelmaster/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @excelmaster/shared && npm run build -w @excelmaster/processor && npm run build -w @excelmaster/api && npm run build -w @excelmaster/worker && npm run build -w @excelmaster/web
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build -w @excelmaster/shared && npm run build -w @excelmaster/processor && npm run build -w @excelmaster/api && npm run build -w @excelmaster/web
scripts.build:api:vercel: npm run build -w @excelmaster/shared && npm run build -w @excelmaster/processor && npm run build -w @excelmaster/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @excelmaster/shared && npm run build -w @excelmaster/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @excelmaster/shared && npm run build -w @excelmaster/processor && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:parser
